messages:
ashley: Heads up — smoke integ against hosted API just went red on CI shard 12 when STREAM_TOOLCALL=1. Failing assertion looks like schema ordering mismatch in tool manifest.
ashley: failing test: tests/integrations/test_toolhook_schema.py::test_schema_order
ashley: logs:
```
E   AssertionError: expected ['name','description','inputs'] got ['description','name','inputs']
... request payload: {
  "tools": [{"description": "...", "name": "summarize", "inputs": {...}}]
}
```
raj: hmm, ordering flip could be from a serialization change (ujson vs std json) or from a dict->OrderedDict regression. any recent deps bumped?
ashley: we upgraded ujson in #4599 and merged a streaming-toolcall refactor in #4622 earlier today. both touched serialization paths.
tanvi: I can repro locally with the same test seed — getting same ordering. looks nondeterministic only when tool metadata populated from model routing path (i.e. routed tools add an extra insertion).
raj: can we rerun just shard 12 and the smoke suite first? if it's a recent merge it should bisect cleanly.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @raj — queued shard 12 smoke (job id ci/2260/shard12). I'll post results here. :gear:
ashley: thanks. if rerun stays red, I'm leaning to a quick fix: canonicalize tool schema before assert (sorted keys) OR normalize at generation time. which should we prefer?
tanvi: short term normalize in test (sorted keys) so CI unblocks. longer term we should fix generator to emit deterministic order. I can open a PR to canonicalize output in the tool manifest builder.
raj: +1. please also capture the minimal commit range to bisect if rerun still red. if it's only in #4599 then revert patch there as hotfix.
sre-bot: note: if the smoke suite for hosted-api has >=3 failing runs in the last hour, please file an incident and tag oncall.
ci-bot: Rerun complete — shard 12 still red (job ci/2260/shard12#2). failing on same assertion.
ashley: ok switching to plan B — patch the test to compare canonicalized schemas and open PR. will also run a local bisect on the merge window to see which PR introduced nondeterminism.
tanvi: I can start bisecting locally (have the tree and env), ping me the commit range to test.
ashley: commit range looks like 96a3c4..b1f2e8 (includes #4599 and #4622). I'll dump a minimal repro and drop it here in a sec.
ashley: repro snippet:
```py
# minimal: generate tool manifest then assert canonical form
manifest = build_tool_manifest(..., include_routing=True)
print(json.dumps(manifest['tools'][0].keys()))
```
raj: solid. once bisect lands, we can decide whether to revert or fix generator. thanks all — test patch + PR will unblock CI quickly.
ashley: filed quick test-only PR to canonicalize before assert: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4678 (test-only). will follow up with generator fix PR after bisect. :thumbsup:
